description: VIS-R&D-001 integrates a static 3D Gaussian splat as a presentation primitive in the mal-fabric GAME view. The native Three.js WebGPURenderer, SPLATLoader, and GaussianSplat path can replace a conventional asset without changing the canonical geometric program, fabric execution, game-loop state, logical tick sequence, or game behavior. Gaussian rendering and fallback remain nonauthoritative; pixels are noncanonical. Includes 24/24 VIS-R&D-001 conformance, 25/25 byte-identical evidence replay, and an unchanged 253/253 predecessor regression floor.
title: mal-fabric v0.8.0: Gaussian Splat Render Primitive
